cohort: 1132 mothers (5% of 22,600 deliveries) with UTI during pregnancy and their newborns, compared to a control group of mothers without UTI
finding: Infants born to mothers with UTI had significantly lower birth weight and height, and UTI in pregnancy was associated with an increased rate of cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: There was a significant association between UTI in pregnancy and mode of delivery (cesarean section).
